beats.open: [[lamp]]One night, a lamp went dark. Someone said it had burned out. Maybe. But the bulb might be fine.
beats.question: [[switch]]A loose switch, a broken wire, or a power cut down the street can look exactly the same from this room.
beats.thought: [[uncertainty]]All we've seen is a light go out. To understand why, we have to look a little closer, one thing at a time.
beats.close: [[honesty]]There is nothing shameful about not knowing yet. That's where finding out begins.
